turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My manager asked me to run a games hour for the team. Twelve people, kind of stiff with each other.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice challenge. Should it be a cooperative game where everyone works together, or a bluffing game that gets people laughing at each other?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Ethan something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you book the cinema for Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet. I wasn't sure which film you wanted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't mind. Anything but horror.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's that comedy everyone's talking about.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine by me. What time does it start?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's a seven o'clock and a nine thirty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seven, so we can eat after.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We'd stopped on what to play with your coworkers. Which feels better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Bluffing. Watching my boss lie badly will break the ice.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, it really does. Pick one with short rounds so everyone gets a turn before the hour runs out.
